abstract:
In this paper, we present a formal complexity and structural invariant analysis of Aether-Framework in the memory of other programs implemented in Swift. We establish rigorous asymptotic bounds under the Balanced Search \& Indexing Structure archetype, validating modular encapsulation, structural bounds, and formal correctness invariants.
